kjv.text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,

web.text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

kjv.text: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

web.text: to the saints and faithful brothers* The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kjv.text: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

web.text: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

kjv.text: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,

web.text: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,

kjv.text: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;

web.text: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News

kjv.text: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:

web.text: which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth,

kjv.text: As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;

web.text: even as you learned of Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on your† NU reads our behalf,

kjv.text: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.

web.text: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.

kjv.text: For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;

web.text: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,

kjv.text: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;

web.text: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God,

kjv.text: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;

web.text: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,

kjv.text: Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:

web.text: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,

kjv.text: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:

web.text: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,

kjv.text: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:

web.text: in whom we have our redemption,‡ TR adds “through his blood,” the forgiveness of our sins.

kjv.text: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:

web.text: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.

kjv.text: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:

web.text: For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers. All things have been created through him and for him.

kjv.text: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.

web.text: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.

kjv.text: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.

web.text: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he might have the preeminence.

kjv.text: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell;

web.text: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,

kjv.text: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.

web.text: and through him to reconcile all things to himself by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.

kjv.text: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled

web.text: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds,

kjv.text: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:

web.text: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,

kjv.text: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;

web.text: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which is being proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, was made a servant.

kjv.text: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the church:

web.text: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly,

kjv.text: Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of God;

web.text: of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God,

kjv.text: Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:

web.text: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,

kjv.text: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:

web.text: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

kjv.text: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:

web.text: We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;

kjv.text: Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.

web.text: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.

kjv.text: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

web.text: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you, and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

kjv.text: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;

web.text: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,

kjv.text: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

web.text: in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.

kjv.text: And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.

web.text: Now I say this that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.

kjv.text: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.

web.text: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet I am with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.

kjv.text: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him:

web.text: As therefore you received Christ Jesus, the Lord, walk in him,

kjv.text: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.

web.text: rooted and built up in him, and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.

kjv.text: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.

web.text: Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elements of the world, and not after Christ.

kjv.text: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.

web.text: For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily,

kjv.text: And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:

web.text: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power.

kjv.text: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:

web.text: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ,

kjv.text: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.

web.text: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.

kjv.text: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;

web.text: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,

kjv.text: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;

web.text: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.

kjv.text: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

web.text: Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

kjv.text: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:

web.text: Let no one therefore judge you in eating, or in drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,

kjv.text: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.

web.text: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.

kjv.text: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

web.text: Let no one rob you of your prize by self-abasement and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

kjv.text: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.

web.text: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God’s growth.

kjv.text: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,

web.text: If you died with Christ from the elements of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,

kjv.text: (Touch not; taste not; handle not;

web.text: “Don’t handle, nor taste, nor touch”

kjv.text: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?

web.text: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?

kjv.text: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.

web.text: These things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, humility, and severity to the body; but aren’t of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.

kjv.text: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.

web.text: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

kjv.text: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.

web.text: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.

kjv.text: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.

web.text: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

kjv.text: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.

web.text: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.

kjv.text: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:

web.text: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.

kjv.text: For which things’ sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:

web.text: For these things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

kjv.text: In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.

web.text: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them;

kjv.text: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.

web.text: but now you also put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.

kjv.text: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;

web.text: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,

kjv.text: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:

web.text: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,

kjv.text: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.

web.text: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.

kjv.text: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;

web.text: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;

kjv.text: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.

web.text: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.

kjv.text: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.

web.text: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

kjv.text: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.

web.text: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.

kjv.text: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.

web.text: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.

kjv.text: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.

web.text: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father, through him.

kjv.text: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.

web.text: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

kjv.text: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.

web.text: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.

kjv.text: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.

web.text: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.

kjv.text: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.

web.text: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.

kjv.text: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God:

web.text: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

kjv.text: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;

web.text: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord, and not for men,

kjv.text: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.

web.text: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.

kjv.text: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.

web.text: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.

kjv.text: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.

web.text: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

kjv.text: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;

web.text: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,

kjv.text: Withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:

web.text: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds,

kjv.text: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.

web.text: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.

kjv.text: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.

web.text: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.

kjv.text: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.

web.text: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

kjv.text: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:

web.text: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.

kjv.text: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;

web.text: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,

kjv.text: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.

web.text: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.

kjv.text: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister’s son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)

web.text: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received commandments, “if he comes to you, receive him”),

kjv.text: And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.

web.text: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.

kjv.text: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

web.text: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

kjv.text: For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.

web.text: For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.

kjv.text: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.

web.text: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.

kjv.text: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.

web.text: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the assembly that is in his house.

kjv.text: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.

web.text: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.

kjv.text: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.

web.text: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”

kjv.text: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.

web.text: The salutation of me, Paul, with my own hand: remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.
